hypothesis: One frozen 4,096-weight quantized hashed-linear correction predicts positive held-out F-minus-O ideal-bit residual from decoder-visible segment state and beats a shifted-label control.
interfaces_exposed: prior decoded segment state -> 4096-weight quantized hashed-linear branch-logit correction
kill_condition: Any causal-feature, leakage, quantization, held-out, shifted-control, segment-consistency, or payload miss retires this exact fixed formulation without sweeps.
promotion_condition: Validation and test ideal-bit gains, every test-third gain, and treatment-over-shifted-control margin must be positive; at least 55 percent of test segments must improve; payload must not exceed 8200 bytes.
retired_neighborhoods: Does not use the current symbol, teacher probability as a feature, hidden state, validation fitting, or the retired output-head GRAM formulation.
title: Compact decoder-visible deep residual prediction
